responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain analytical solutions that support business reporting, performance tracking, and data driven decision-making.
Translate business requirements into scalable data models, reporting layers, dashboards, and actionable analytical outputs.
Develop and maintain data preparation and transformation logic using SQL, Python, and cloud-based analytics platforms such as Azure Databricks.
Build and enhance structured datasets and reporting-ready data models to support Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and recurring analytical use cases.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability through validation, reconciliation, testing, and documentation of business logic.
Support automation and continuous improvement of reporting processes, data workflows, and recurring analytical activities.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and IT/data teams to understand requirements and deliver reliable analytics solutions.
Support business users with ad hoc analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and interpretation of analytical insights.
Contribute to agile delivery by supporting requirement gathering, solution design, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
